quote.text:
Opus 5.5 absolutely DESTROYED the http://4elements.dev benchmark.

When you put it next to the other models, it's just the best one for 3D and working inside Three.js.

It took a really long time, but it was so thorough. I watched it come back and iterate over and over until it got the result right.

Reminds me of the old Fable 5. I really love how autonomous it was. One prompt and it knew exactly what to do, then it just kept going until the job was done properly.

I'm really satisfied with how it looks in the 3D world. Definitely going to test it more on long, complex tasks.

I'll share more, so make sure to follow.
